_note: One of the 20 sets of ichava/icon-sets-extras, each refreshed by its own config into files/<set>/ and licenses/<set>/, with its version recorded at upstream.sets.<set>.current_version in the pack's config.json. dist/icons/*.svg, underscores slugged to hyphens. Pinhead incorporates icons from Temaki, Maki, OpenStreetMap Carto, Osmic, Health Icons and others; its README lists every source as CC0 or public domain. Reproduces the committed pack byte for byte: a dry run at the pinned version against the local checkout on 2026-11-04 wrote 2,747 SVGs with 0 added, removed or changed.
